title: Lombard Loans UK
summary: Service page of Silver Oak Capital (London debt advisory) describing Lombard lending: borrowing against liquid assets (bonds, equities, cash, mutual funds, ETFs) while retaining ownership of the holdings and continuing to benefit from capital appreciation, dividends and income. Search snippets reveal indicative LTV ranges by collateral type (bonds 70-90%, equities 50-70%, cash 90-100%), a statement that these loans suit short- to medium-term needs rather than long-term ones, and a claim of access to a network of hundreds of lenders including private banks. No fees, rates, loan sizes, timescales, process steps, H1 or meta description were revealed by the searches. The seed file held no snippet for this page. Page indexed title: 'Lombard Loans UK'; the search tool noted the page was last indexed ~213 days before 2026-10-29.
